meta.source: Ministry of Religious Affairs and Awqaf (Algeria) - prayer timetable 1448 AH (2026-06-16 to 2027-06-05)
notes: Algiers times come directly from the timetable.
Other cities = Algiers time + the monthly minute offset printed in the timetable for that city, prayer and Hijri month.
qibla_sun is the time the sun is in the qibla direction (Algiers only); null where the timetable shows no value.
Timetable is not for printing/copying without Ministry permission as stated on the source.
